value.summary:
WP-1 is done: I added the new 422 and expired-link errors and the alias and lookup code rules, without changing any existing behaviour. `python -m compileall -q app` succeeds and all 165 existing tests pass.

**`app/core/errors.py`** (additions only):
- `LINK_EXPIRED_DETAIL = "Link has expired"`.
- `LinkExpiredError(GoneError)`: returns 410 (inherited) with that detail.
- `UnprocessableEntityError(AppError)`: returns 422 with detail "Unprocessable entity".
- `GoneError` still says "Link has been deactivated", and the existing error handlers are unchanged.

**`app/services/codes.py`**:
- `RESERVED_CODES` now also includes "metrics". All 8 existing entries are still there.
- `generate_code`, `is_reserved`, `CODE_PATTERN` and `is_valid_code_format` are unchanged, so "abc-123" is still invalid as a generated code. The module still uses `secrets` and never `random`.
- New constants: `ALIAS_MIN_LENGTH` (3), `ALIAS_MAX_LENGTH` (32), `ALIAS_PATTERN` (3–32 characters) and `LOOKUP_CODE_PATTERN` (1–32 characters). Both patterns allow only explicit ASCII ranges: letters, digits, `_` and `-`.
- New functions `is_valid_alias` and `is_valid_lookup_code`. Both use `fullmatch`, so a trailing newline never matches. Both have docstrings.
notes: `LinkExpiredError` is placed after `GoneError` because it subclasses it, and `UnprocessableEntityError` comes after it.
errors.py imports nothing new, so the architecture test's ban on importing services, repositories or the api layer from it still holds.
open_issues: Nothing calls the new functions yet. WP-4 will use `is_valid_lookup_code`, `is_valid_alias`, `UnprocessableEntityError` and `LinkExpiredError` in `link_service.py` and `stats_service.py`.
